component: Lazy custom-element document and global ownership

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1035's helper resolves immediately for an interactive or complete document and otherwise waits once for DOMContentLoaded. It then registers an element-creation callback whose import uses global: "current". The helper's state and document/customElements belong to that content context. Use the current-global import contract for these document-bound modules; this is not a rule to use current globals for system modules. No document-load or element-creation runtime was run.
title: Wait for document readiness before registering a lazy custom-element callback
